The [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vanquo]] had a '''moon''' that could be seen in the sky on clear nights. The [[Moon/Legends|moon]] had a green [[Color/Legends|color]], and appeared large in the night sky when visible.
